conclusion: A 26-chip word is recovered only when the rolling readout spans at least 26 display symbol periods. At 60 Hz (16.7 ms per symbol) a 27 ms readout sees only ~1.6 symbols, so a full blink word cannot fit in one capture; 240 Hz is still far short. At 1000 Hz the same readout sees ~27 symbols and all three IDs decode. This is the central temporal constraint of the proposed architecture, and it is a physical/arithmetic result, not a software limitation.

summary.physical_limit: visible display symbols = height * row_time / symbol_period; camera frame rate does not multiply display refresh rate

title: Temporal blink IDs under a rolling-shutter capture
